fusions.name: Through the Bars
fusions.desc: A thrust that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Dropped Portcullis
fusions.desc: Drops a ring of bars on every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage, stunning them for 1.2 seconds and leaving them [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gibbet Lock
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Kept at Arm's Length
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions lifts, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
